title: TMP Camera Surveillance Next 2.20.95
summary: Optionaler Live-Ton in der HTTPS-Cloud-WebApp, nur wenn Kunden eine Kamera ausdrücklich mit Audio öffnen.
changes: Add authenticated POST /api/streams/:id/cloud-audio to start an optional live stream with audio
Keep permanent camera previews and kiosk HLS video-only to preserve startup speed and stability
Strict outbound-HTTPS proxy allowlist: only opt-in POST, no session-management or admin writes
Private Plesk PHP 3.1.1 adds text-only Ton einschalten/ausschalten controls, iPhone playback gesture support and audio token renewal
Preserve all original recordings, NAS data, camera identities, database and existing Cloud login sessions
name: TMP Camera Surveillance Next v2.20.95
description: Add opt-in, protected live camera sound to mobile HTTPS cloud portal without altering the fast default live HLS
releaseNotes: Deploy private Plesk PHP 3.1.1 first, then update camera backend to 2.20.95. Cloud live audio is only available when the camera source actually provides a usable microphone track. Safari might require an additional user tap.
